Voice

60

Backup voice

Volume sets how loud the talking is. Puzzle Pals talks with a recorded voice; if a recording can't play on this device, the backup voice you pick here reads it instead. The ones marked with a star sound the most natural.

To keep Puzzle Pals on your home screen: on iPhone or iPad tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen". On Android tap the menu, then "Install app".

Music

20

Slide to make the music louder or softer. Tap a song to play it. While you play, a new song fades in every 4 minutes. With "World songs" on, each world plays its own song, like steel drums for Ocean & Pirates.

Background

Tap a picture to change the background. With "Match each world" on, each world shows its own scene while you play it, like Under the Sea for Ocean & Pirates.
